main_text.p: Peccant denique in rempubli-cam, dum in eâlites novas excitant, & veteres adaugent.

Hinc ipsæ familiæ quinimò integræ gentes mutuis inter sese inimicitiis & discordiis irritantur. Pars læsa ultionem quotidie meditatur & vindi-ctam reposcit, ut ad concilian-dos utrinque animos jam no-voopus sit Hercule.Neq;inter familiares aut inter proximos, incolumis est amicitia. Ruunt enim in consanguineos consanguinei, & in amicos amici. Quibusque ex officio omnia humanitatis officia debebantur, illis & vulnera & cædes minamur. Et si poetæ cuidam Gallo fides, cruenta equidem illa, & lectorem in commiseratione rapiens tragœdia, in quâ introducit filiū defendentem duello patris honorem, in præjudicium sui

page.notes: Printed "no-voopus" at the line end: the word is likely "novo opus" with a misplaced space; copied as printed. "Hercule.Neq;inter" is run together in print. Printed "vindi-&ctam": the ligature is transcribed as "ctam". "Ruunt" is printed with a hyphen at the line end and the u is a vowel, so it is kept. The first line is a continuation from the previous page. The catchword "amo" is at the foot right.
